home.title: Garden Desk - Your work. Your space.
home.description: An AI coworker for your files that runs entirely on your computer. One download, nothing to configure, nothing tracked, and no way online.
home.lede: Cloud privacy has limits. Your AI coworker stays on your computer.
home.platforms: Apple silicon, or Windows with NVIDIA or AMD graphics
home.openSource: Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Read every line ↗
home.availability: No account. No sign-up. No keys.
home.sceneLabel: A wooden desk and chair in a private Amsterdam townhouse roof garden, with a stair entrance, small trees, low shrubs, gabled houses, canals, bridges, and a distant sea view
home.originNote: The private tools we found were made for developers: install a runtime, pick a model, wire it together. Everything simple sent the work to a cloud. Garden Desk is one download that asks nothing of you. About the name: the cloud is a noisy city with no privacy. Garden Desk is your own desk in a private backyard, where nobody tracks you.
home.claim.one.title: One download
home.claim.one.text: The app and the model, together.
home.claim.config.title: Nothing to configure
home.claim.config.text: Open it. Point it at a folder.
home.claim.tracked.title: Nothing tracked
home.claim.tracked.text: No analytics. No crash reports. No telemetry.
home.claim.online.title: No way online
home.claim.online.text: The model has no route to the internet.
home.claimsNote: Garden Desk makes no network calls of its own. There is no telemetry, no error report, not even an update check. The agent works inside a virtual machine with no network connection at all, and the folder you select is mounted read-only. The model cannot reach the internet, and it cannot change your originals.
home.stepsTitle: Open it. Point it. Ask it.
home.stepsLede: That’s the whole onboarding. There is no step four.
home.step.1.title: Open Garden Desk
home.step.1.text: No account. No key. The model is already there.
home.step.2.title: Point at your work
home.step.2.text: Pick a folder or attach files. Your source stays read-only.
home.step.3.title: Ask, then check the receipts
home.step.3.text: Describe the outcome. Inspect the answer, the files, every step.
home.demoLede: The actual desktop app, on invented data. Runs in browser memory: no model, no upload, nothing saved.
home.demoToolbar: Interactive demo with synthetic sample data
home.demoFrame: Garden Desk interactive demo with synthetic sample data
home.modelTitle: Ternary Bonsai 2 runs on your computer.
home.modelText: It runs completely offline. Text, image inspection, and file tasks stay on your computer.
home.modelSmall: V1 model: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, an Apache-2.0 open model built from Qwen3.8-27B. Verified on macOS and on Windows.
home.compareLede: Seven ways to get the work done. The same nine questions. Checked against public documentation in September 2026.
home.compareCaption: Garden Desk compared with six other ways to get AI work done
home.note.1: The model ships inside the download and runs on your computer. There is nothing to pick or install.
home.note.2: You choose a local or a cloud model, and you install and select it yourself.
home.note.3: You run a local model server and point the tool at it.
home.note.4: Prompts, skills, and workflows are tuned end to end for one model. A tool that accepts any model cannot tune for each one.
home.note.5: The model can run locally, but the app still calls vendor services.
home.note.6: Agent commands run inside a virtual machine that has no network interface at all. The other tools run commands on your computer or on vendor servers, with a network.
home.note.7: The folder you select is mounted read-only. The agent writes only to a separate workspace, so it cannot change your originals.
home.note.8: An account service. Your work runs on the vendor's computers.
home.note.10: Update and model-catalog checks still run until you turn them off.
home.note.11: ChatGPT Business is $25 for each seat each month, or $20 when you pay yearly. Premium is $125, or $100 yearly. Business needs two seats or more.
home.note.12: Local models are free. Bionic+ is $20 each month and Pro is $100.

home.sourceText: Every claim on this page is about software you can open. Apache 2.0, fully public. Go find the telemetry. There is none.

supporters.title: Supporters | Garden Desk
supporters.description: The people and companies who fund Garden Desk development.
supporters.h1: Paid for by the people who use it.
supporters.lede: Garden Desk is free and open source, and it stays that way. Sponsorship pays for the time, the test machines, and the certificates behind each release.
supporters.pays1: The time to keep the model, the sandbox, and the app current.
supporters.pays2: Code-signing certificates for macOS and Windows, so downloads open without warnings.
supporters.pays3: Test hardware: Macs and PCs, so every release is verified on the machines people actually own.
supporters.strings: There is nothing to unlock. Every feature is free for everyone, sponsored or not. Sponsorship does not buy a feature, a release date, or a place in the roadmap. You keep a private tool private, for everyone.
supporters.list1: Backers are listed by name. Sponsors add a logo and a link. Company sponsors appear at the top of this page. Sponsors and company sponsors are also listed in the project README, and both places are updated by hand with each release, so a new entry can take a few days to appear.
supporters.list2: Being listed is optional. Sponsor privately, or write to developer@gardendesk.ai and your entry is removed. Nothing on this page is tracked, and no sponsor data is collected here.
supporters.support: Sponsor Garden Desk on GitHub. One-time and monthly amounts both help.
